quizzes.title: Module 1 Quiz: Starting Out as a Bookkeeping VA

questions.text: What does a Bookkeeping VA primarily do?
choices: Records transactions, categorizes expenses, and keeps financial records accurate
Handles a company's social media posts
Repairs computer hardware
Manages warehouse inventory

questions.text: Why do most small business owners hire a Bookkeeping VA?
choices: They are legally required to
They lack the time or training to keep their books current
It is cheaper than hiring no one
Bookkeeping software requires a license to use

questions.text: In the chart of accounts, transactions are typically grouped into categories such as:
choices: Income, expenses, assets, liabilities, and equity
Colors, sizes, and shapes
Only income and expenses
Random alphabetical order

questions.text: What is the main difference between cash basis and accrual basis bookkeeping?
choices: There is no real difference
Cash basis records transactions when money moves; accrual records when income is earned or expenses billed
Accrual basis is only for personal budgets
Cash basis is illegal for small businesses

questions.text: What is a key part of setting up a productive home workspace for bookkeeping work?
choices: A secure, private space and strong password habits
Working only from a public computer
Avoiding all accounting software
Sharing your client login with friends

questions.text: Why is QuickBooks Online considered essential to learn?
choices: It is the most widely used small business accounting software
It is only used by large corporations
It cannot be accessed remotely
It replaces the need for bookkeeping knowledge

questions.text: What is Xero primarily used for?
choices: Social media scheduling
Cloud-based accounting, similar in purpose to QuickBooks Online
Video editing
Email marketing

questions.text: Why might a Bookkeeping VA recommend Wave to a client?
choices: It's a free accounting tool that covers invoicing, transactions, and basic reports
It's the most expensive option available
It only works for large enterprises
It has no invoicing feature

questions.text: What is the purpose of receipt-scanning apps like Dext or Hubdoc?
choices: To automatically extract and sync receipt details into accounting software
To design social media graphics
To process payroll taxes
To schedule client meetings

questions.text: What is one benefit of connecting a client's bank feed to their accounting software?
choices: It eliminates the need to ever review transactions
It saves time by pulling transactions in automatically for review
It guarantees zero errors
It removes the need for a chart of accounts

questions.text: Which of these is a common, low-cost tool for building custom client reports or trackers?
choices: Google Sheets
Photoshop
Final Cut Pro
AutoCAD

questions.text: When should a Bookkeeping VA choose a free tool like Wave over QuickBooks or Xero?
choices: Never, free tools should always be avoided
When a client is very small or just starting out with a limited budget
Only for clients with over 10,000 transactions per month
Free tools should be used for every client regardless of size

questions.text: What does 'categorizing' a transaction mean?
choices: Assigning it to the correct account in the chart of accounts
Deleting it from the records
Converting it to a different currency
Ignoring it until year-end

questions.text: What is the purpose of bank reconciliation?
choices: To confirm the books match the actual bank or credit card statement
To design invoices
To calculate payroll taxes
To create social media content

questions.text: What should you do when you find a transaction that appears twice during reconciliation?
choices: Ignore it completely
Investigate and remove or correct the duplicate
Delete the entire month's records
Assume the bank made an error and do nothing

questions.text: What does an accounts receivable aging report show?
choices: How overdue outstanding customer invoices are
A list of the client's social media followers
The business's tax filing deadlines
Employee vacation days

questions.text: What does a Profit & Loss statement show?
choices: Total income minus total expenses over a period
A list of the company's employees
The business's social media engagement
A snapshot of assets and liabilities only

questions.text: What is a 'mock set of books' used for in a portfolio?
choices: A real paid client project
A sample set of records created to demonstrate your skills
A type of scam
A required legal filing

questions.text: How should mock or sample work be labeled in a portfolio?
choices: As real client results with no disclaimer
Clearly and honestly as sample or practice work
They should never be shown
As guaranteed outcomes for future clients

questions.text: What is a good way to showcase skills in a bookkeeping portfolio?
choices: Vague claims with no specifics
Clean sample reports like a P&L and balance sheet generated from mock books
Only screenshots of unrelated social media posts
Avoiding any samples entirely

questions.text: Which free tools work well for building a simple portfolio page?
choices: Carrd or a well-organized Google Drive folder
Only expensive custom-built websites
None exist for free
Only printed paper portfolios

questions.text: Why is a portfolio valuable even without paid bookkeeping client experience?
choices: It has no real value
It proves your skills with recording, reconciling, and reporting
It replaces the need for any actual skills
Clients never look at portfolios

quizzes.title: Module 5 Quiz: Resume and Job Applications

questions.text: What should a Bookkeeping VA resume bullet point focus on?
choices: Vague statements with no detail
Specific accomplishments, like reconciling accounts or producing accurate reports
Only job titles
Personal hobbies unrelated to the role

questions.text: What makes a strong proposal for a bookkeeping job posting?
choices: A generic copy-paste message sent to everyone
Personalization that references the client's actual situation and needs
Extremely long, unfocused paragraphs
No mention of relevant software skills

questions.text: Which platforms are commonly used to find Bookkeeping VA clients?
choices: OnlineJobs.ph and Upwork
Only local newspapers
Random unrelated apps
None, clients cannot be found online

questions.text: What is a good goal during a discovery call with a potential bookkeeping client?
choices: Avoid asking any questions
Understand how current their books are and what software they use
Immediately demand payment before speaking
Refuse to discuss the client's business

questions.text: A good freelance profile headline for a Bookkeeping VA should be:
choices: Vague, like 'Hardworking VA'
Specific, naming the software and services you offer
Left blank
Written only in technical jargon

quizzes.title: Module 6 Quiz: Landing Your First Client and Beyond

questions.text: What is a good first step when onboarding a new bookkeeping client?
choices: Guess what they want without asking
Gain safe software access and collect financial documents in writing
Immediately increase your rate
Avoid all communication in week one

questions.text: Which is a common pricing model for Bookkeeping VA services?
choices: Monthly retainer
Random guessing
Refusing to state a price
Charging only in a currency you don't understand

questions.text: What is a practical way to manage multiple clients' books without mixing them up?
choices: Use one shared login for every client
Double-check which company file you're in before entering data
Copy one client's chart of accounts into another's
Avoid using any organizational tools

questions.text: How should a Bookkeeping VA respond to a client questioning a number in a report?
choices: Take it personally and stop responding
Investigate calmly and explain findings in plain language
Argue that the client is always wrong
Ignore the question completely

questions.text: What should generally be excluded from a Bookkeeping VA's scope of work?
choices: Bank reconciliation
Tax filing and formal financial advice
Categorizing transactions
Producing basic reports

questions.text: What is a sign that a Bookkeeping VA may have reached capacity with clients?
choices: Missed reconciliations and rushed categorizing
Perfectly on-time reports every month
Too few clients to manage
Consistently accurate books

questions.text: What helps build a long-term Bookkeeping VA career?
choices: Refusing to learn new software or skills
Asking for testimonials and continuously learning new reporting skills
Never asking for client feedback
Avoiding all specialization
